name: nema23_adapter
summary: Flat adapter plate: a NEMA 23 stepper motor mounts on top and the plate bolts down to a 3030 aluminium T-slot extrusion underneath. Flat plate only, no upright, no gusset.

features.name: plate
features.purpose: Flat plate: carries the NEMA 23 motor face on top (+Z) and the 3030 extrusion T-nut pair underneath (-Z).
